# Travel Itinerary Skill for Muse

The after-booking complement to trip planners: feed it your scattered booking confirmations, emails, tickets, PDFs, screenshots, or meeting notes and it extracts the facts into a structured, day-by-day business-trip itinerary — flights, hotels, transfers, meetings, restaurants — with route links between stops and timezone-safe scheduling. Its standout discipline is privacy-aware exporting: separate internal, team-share, executive, and travel-admin variants with sensitive fields (payment, passport, loyalty, booking PINs) redacted per export, plus Markdown, PDF, DOCX, Google Doc, and .ics calendar outputs. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it never claims live facts — flight status, prices, and hours stay as stated in your source documents unless a live tool verifies them in-session. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
